# About SalesMail

At SalesMail, we believe that meaningful relationships drive business growth and that every message should feel personal.

Our app helps sales and marketing professionals send short, branded videos that build trust, boost engagement, and close deals faster. Whether it’s a warm welcome, a follow-up, or a simple thank-you, SalesMail makes it effortless to add a human touch to every interaction.

![About SalesMail | SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/69288ec0a54a6c2c6eb101dc_about-salesmail.avif)

## Our mission

We are obsessed with delivering world-class service to our business partners, empowering them to build strong relationships and create memorable experiences with the audiences that matter most to them.

That commitment shows up in everything we do, from how we design our software, to how we support our users, to the results they achieve.

[![UI Icon Mail RG| SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6925e351a8d671e3c6fc5f71_ui-icon-mail-rg.svg)\\
\\
Book a demo](https://www.salesmail.com/demo)

![SalesMail Team | SalesMail](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6928915686c2413fe598b617_salesmail-team.avif)

## Why we exist

In a world of automation and AI, authenticity and human connection wins.

SalesMail helps organizations make every prospect, customer, resident, or guest feel seen, valued, and connected.

We serve industries where trust and empathy matter most – senior living, multifamily, hospitality, real estate, and beyond – helping teams connect personally, perform better, and stand out in a sea of sameness.

[See how it works](https://www.salesmail.com/how-it-works)
